# Text

`ui.text` · parts: `Text` · elements: `<p>`

## Purpose

Text is the polymorphic text primitive. `tag` accepts HTML5 text elements
only (p, span, h1–h6, blockquote, code, …); anything else falls back to p.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- Headings: `tag="h1"`…`h6`; never style a `p` to look like a heading.
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Text renders the requested text element (default p).

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Tag` | `tag` | `tag` | `"p" \| "span" \| "h1" \| "h2" \| "h3" \| "h4" \| "h5" \| "h6" \| "blockquote" \| "figcaption" \| "pre" \| "code" \| "small" \| "strong" \| "em" \| "time" \| "legend" \| "del" \| "ins"` | — | prop | HTML5 text tag (default p) |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- No ARIA attributes are rendered by the primitive; rely on native semantics. Pass extra `aria-*` through attrs.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `textClasses({ ... })` from `text/text.shared.ts` |
| templ | `text.TextClasses(text.TextProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('textClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::textClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `text_classes(p)` |

React additionally supports `asChild` (merges props onto the single child via [Slot](slot.md)).

## Usage

Fixture `h1` (`{"Tag":"h1","Class":"text-2xl font-semibold"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<h1 class="text-2xl font-semibold">Content</h1>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Text } from "./ui/text/text";

<Text tag="h1" className="text-2xl font-semibold">Content</Text>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Text from "./ui/text/Text.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Text tag="h1" class="text-2xl font-semibold">Content</Text>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Text from "./ui/text/Text.svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="h1" class="text-2xl font-semibold">Content</Text>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Text } from "./ui/text/text.solid";

<Text tag="h1" class="text-2xl font-semibold">Content</Text>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderText } from "./ui/text/text.wc";

document.body.append(renderText({ tag: "h1", class: "text-2xl font-semibold" }, "Content"));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/text"

@text.Text(text.TextProps{Tag: "h1", Class: "text-2xl font-semibold"}) {
	Content
}
```

**Twig** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/twig.md))

```twig
{% include 'text/Text.html.twig' with { tag: 'h1', class: 'text-2xl font-semibold', children: 'Content' } only %}
```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```latte
{include 'text/Text.latte', tag: 'h1', class: 'text-2xl font-semibold', children: 'Content'}
```

**Jinja2** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/jinja2.md))

```jinja
{% with p = {'Tag': 'h1', 'Class': 'text-2xl font-semibold'}, children = 'Content' %}{% include 'ui/text/text.html.j2' %}{% endwith %}
```
